unlock_entries.trigger: after food unlock, at least 400 game meat across eligible granaries

eligible_granaries: Road-accessible, active granaries with at least 50 percent staffing; qualifying meat is summed across them.
meat_gate_reference: 0x004502f0, aggregate granary loop and threshold at 0x00450535
hazard_reference: 0x0045aec0; fire invokes unlock 0, collapse invokes unlock 3

victory.reference: 0x004ced40 reads housing goal and invokes 0x004cecf0; occupied active housing at or above threshold is weighted by the table at 0x0056488c

initial_funds.reference: Initialization at 0x004c64d7 reads table 0x005659f8 and applies percentage helper 0x004b6e70

nile_prototype_limits: Uses independently authored 32 by 32 terrain, not the original 84 by 84 map.
Hunt yield and journey cadence, renewable prey patches, service duration, labor and hazard cadence remain prototype tuning.
